### Page note: https://extapps.dec.ny.gov/docs/lands_forests_pdf/isprohibitedplants2.pdf
Reader state: complete; relevance: partial
**Page:** DEC Prohibited and Regulated Invasive Plants – https://extapps.dec.ny.gov/docs/lands_forests_pdf/isprohibitedplants2.pdf

**Evidence**  
The PDF contains a series of “PROHIBITED” blocks that list the scientific names of each plant. Two‑column examples from the document are:  

1. “PROHIBITED PROHIBITED PROHIBITED  
# TERRESTRIAL PLANTS  
Amur Cork Tree   Phellodendron amurense  Amur Honeysuckle   Lonicera maackii  Autumn Olive   Elaeagnus umbellata”  
2. “PROHIBITED PROHIBITED PROHIBITED  
Beach Vitex  Vitex rotundifolia  Black Swallow‑wort  Cynanchum louiseae  Bohemian Knotweed  Reynoutria × bohemica”  
3. “PROHIBITED PROHIBITED PROHIBITED  
Common Reed Grass  Phragmites australis  Marsh Dewfower  Murdannia keisak  Purple Loosestrife  Lythrum salicaria”  
4. “PROHIBITED PROHIBITED PROHIBITED  
Brazilian Waterweed  Egeria densa  Broadleaf Water‑milfoil  Myriophyllum heterophyllum × M. laxum  Curly Pondweed  Potamogeton crispus”  
5. “PROHIBITED PROHIBITED PROHIBITED  
Water Chestnut  Trapa natans  Yellow Floating Heart  Nymphoides peltata”  

Each of these sections lists precisely the plants that are prohibited under NYS law.

**Missing**  
None – the page provides a complete list of all prohibited species (the regulated species are in separate “REGULATED” blocks).  

**Next links**  
None – the current PDF is self‑contained and no further links are required for this question.

### Page note: https://extapps.dec.ny.gov/docs/lands_forests_pdf/isprohibitedplants2.pdf
Reader state: complete; relevance: partial
**Page:** NEW YORK STATE PROHIBITED AND REGULATED INVASIVE PLANTS (DEC PDF) – https://extapps.dec.ny.gov/docs/lands_forests_pdf/isprohibitedplants2.pdf  
**Evidence:**  
*Prohibited Terrestrial Plants*  
- Amur Cork Tree (Phellodendron amurense)  
- Amur Honeysuckle (Lonicera maackii)  
- Autumn Olive (Elaeagnus umbellata)  
- Beach Vitex (Vitex rotundifolia)  
- Black Swallow‑wort (Cynanchum louiseae) [also listed as (C. nigrum, Vincetoxicum nigrum)]  
- Bohemian Knotweed (Reynoutria × bohemica) [also (Fallopia × bohemica, Polygonum × bohemica)]  
- Border Privet (Ligustrum obtusifolium)  
- Broad‑leafed Pepper‑grass (Lepidium latifolium)  
- Canada Thistle (Cirsium arvense) [also (C. setosum, C. incanum, Serratula arvensis)]  
- Chinese Lespedeza (Lespedeza cuneata)  
- Chinese Yam (Dioscorea polystachya) [also (D. batatas)]  
- Cogon Grass (Imperata cylindrica) [also (I. arundinacea, Lagurus cylindricus)]  
- Common Buckthorn (Rhamnus cathartica)  
- Cup‑plant (Silphium perfoliatum)  
- Cut‑leaf Teasel (Dipsacus laciniatus)  
- Cypress Spurge (Euphorbia cyparissias)  
- Fly Honeysuckle (Lonicera × bella)  
- Garden Loosestrife (Lysimachia vulgaris)  
- Garlic Mustard (Alliaria petiolata)  
- Giant Hogweed (Heracleum mantegazzianum)  
- Giant Knotweed (Reynoutria sachalinensis) [also (Fallopia sachalinensis, Polygonum sachalinensis)]  
- Golden Bamboo (Phyllostachys aurea)  
- Gray Florist’s Willow (Salix atrocinerea)  
- Japanese Angelica Tree (Aralia elata)  
- Japanese Barberry (Berberis thunbergii)  
- Japanese Chaff Flower (Achyranthes japonica)  
- Japanese Honeysuckle (Lonicera japonica)  
- Japanese Hops (Humulus japonicus)  
- Japanese Knotweed (Reynoutria japonica) [also (Fallopia japonica, Polygonum cuspidatum)]  
- Japanese Stilt Grass (Microstegium vimineum)  
- Kudzu (Pueraria montana)  
- Leafy Spurge (Euphorbia esula)  
- Lesser Celandine (Ficaria verna) [also (Ranunculus fcaria)]  
- Mile‑a‑minute Weed (Persicaria perfoliata) [also (Polygonum perfoliatum)]  
- Multifora Rose (Rosa multifora)  
- Pale Swallow‑wort (Cynanchum rossicum) [also (C. medium, Vincetoxicum medium, V. rossicum)]  
- Porcelain Berry (Ampelopsis brevipedunculata)  
- Slender False Brome (Brachypodium sylvaticum)  
- Small Carpetgrass (Arthraxon hispidus)  
- Spotted Knapweed (Centaurea stoebe) [also (C. biebersteinii, C. diffusa, C. maculosa misapplied, C. xpsammogena)]  
- Sycamore Maple (Acer pseudoplatanus)  
- Tartarian Honeysuckle (Lonicera tatarica)  
- Wavyleaf Basketgrass (Oplismenus hirtellus)  
- Wild Chervil (Anthriscus sylvestris)  
- Wineberry (Rubus phoenicolasius)  

*Prohibited Wetland Plants*  
- Common Reed Grass (Phragmites australis)  
- Marsh Dewfower (Murdannia keisak)  
- Purple Loosestrife (Lythrum salicaria)  
- Reed Manna Grass (Glyceria maxima)  
- Smooth Buck‑thorn (Frangula alnus) [also (Rhamnus frangula)]  
- Yellow Iris (Iris pseudacorus)  

*Prohibited Aquatic Plants*  
- Brazilian Waterweed (Egeria densa)  
- Broadleaf Water‑milfoil (Hybrid Myriophyllum heterophyllum × M. laxum)  
- Curly Pondweed (Potamogeton crispus)  
- Eurasian Water‑milfoil (Myriophyllum spicatum)  
- Fanwort (Cabomba caroliniana)  
- Floating Primrose Willow (Ludwigia peploides)  
- Frogbit (Hydrocharis morsus‑ranae)  
- Hydrilla/Water Thyme (Hydrilla verticillata)  
- Parrot‑feather (Myriophyllum aquaticum)  
- Uruguayan Primrose Willow (Ludwigia hexapetala) [also (L. grandifora)]  
- Water Chestnut (Trapa natans)  
- Yellow Floating Heart (Nymphoides peltata)  

**Missing:** The supplied page includes the complete list of prohibited terrestrial, wetland, and aquatic plants. No requested field (such as the regulation enforcement date or specific grace periods other than the Japanese Barberry one) is missing from this page.

**Next links:**  
- The PDF contains a link to the full regulations: `http://www.dec.ny.gov/regulations/2359.html` – this page could provide additional detail on each species’ regulatory status and enforcement.  

**Status:** partial (provides the full prohibited plant list but does not cover regulatory enforcement, grace periods, or other policy details beyond the list itself.)
